question: Does the unchanged stable offline Manhattan182 packed dispatcher save at least5% complete answer-production cost against each of newly executed standalone LP96 and always-BP geometry cascade controls on the complete examined H2br cohort?
scope: Performance-only experiment on all4096 examined H2br mazes and all3immutable models. No new fit, generator draw, accuracy observation, population interval, generalization, online latency or causal distance claim. This directly tests alternatives; H2bs only tests packing against the original-order dispatcher.

information_available_before_design.H2br: Full audit passed. BP joint4048/4096, other arms4096/4096. Original dispatcher costs14.040812% more than LP96 and30.414958% more than always-cascade at separate six-block medians. All outcomes and timing blocks from H2br are known.
information_available_before_design.H2bs: Source gates and independent source replay passed; full six-pair timing is running. Its final source-preservation audit and complete-cost endpoint have not been joined or read. Its >=10% target and all existing protocol bytes stay unchanged.
information_available_before_design.design_motivation: A >=10% gain over a slower dispatcher would not establish an improvement over the alternative solvers. Both alternatives must be newly timed under the same charged host harness.

source.prerequisite: H2bs full source-preservation audit must pass before any changed H2bt source gate or timing. Its cost outcome is not an eligibility filter. Bind both prior seals/audits and all exact H2br data, parameters and actual block0 LP96/cascade/dispatcher source archives. Preserve any failure as incomplete; no repair, substitution, retry or budget extension is authorized by this design.

table_order: BP AdamW H2br executed prefix, source context only; standalone service cost unmeasured
LP96 standalone, newly executed complete-cohort control
Always BP geometry cascade, newly executed complete-cohort control
Stable packed Manhattan182 dispatcher, newly executed candidate

fixed_actual_modes.LP96: Use the unchanged endpoint_dispatch_batch.run('LP96') on original consecutive32-input batches. Prepare exactly the LP model and its float64 copy for each seed, as required by this solver. No unnecessary BP model is loaded or charged.
fixed_actual_modes.BP_geometry_LP96: Use the unchanged endpoint_dispatch_batch.run('BP_geometry_LP96') on original consecutive32-input batches. Prepare BP and LP models and both float64 copies for each seed. Execute full BP, actual geometry screening and only the required LP rescue subset.
fixed_actual_modes.packed_dispatch: Use the unchanged H2bs stable high-first queue, true partial-batch materialization, global scatter and unchanged endpoint_dispatch_batch.run('endpoint_dispatch'). For each model classify actual endpoint tokens inside charged host preparation, keep ascending global identities within D>=182 and D<182 groups, process high then low, and keep LP rescues inside their own high batch. No rescue regrouping, padding, duplicates or drops.

common_complete_cost_harness.actual_charges: All3models are processed in seed order0,1,2 with fresh complete readiness for every actual arm/cohort. Charge each arm's actual required checkpoint/model/double preparation; per-model queue/index construction; candidate endpoint extraction and classification; each actual host batch materialization; transfer; hidden/readout; every executed solver dependency, geometry check and original-model certificate; returns/subset mapping; and global output allocation/scatter/final identity validation. Controls incur their actual original-order identity preparation/materialization/scatter, without unused candidate classification.
common_complete_cost_harness.common_representation: Preload the same original shard-token representation before both modes, separately recorded outside answer cost. Candidate packing remains inside charged per-model preparation/materialization; no packed token copy or selected answer is prepared in excluded preload.
common_complete_cost_harness.host_barriers: Use exactly129predetermined host slots per model,387per cohort, and the H2bs readiness/preparation/materialization/answer/scatter/finalization host barrier boundaries. LP96 and always-cascade each have128real batches/model and one trailing zero-work host slot. Packed has129real batches/model on this fixed cohort:2370high and1726low inputs produce75and54true batches, including final cardinalities2and30. Zero slots perform no GPU call or input evaluation and charge no fictitious answer time. Every real input operation is charged. Both workers drain archives before any charged stage and complete the stage before either excluded diagnostic/archive stage.
common_complete_cost_harness.exclusions: Imports, CUDA initialization, fixed source warmups, raw source file preload, independent audits, archives, scientific diagnostics and synchronization waits are separately recorded outside complete answer cost and inside worker wall limits. No independent CPU audit or extraction overlaps changed GPU timing.
common_complete_cost_harness.offline_scope: The entire examined cohort is available before processing. This measures complete offline cohort answer production under the warmed runtime/filesystem-cache regime. Arrival waiting time, online request latency and hardware-general performance are outside scope. Historical H2br or H2bs times are not substituted for any newly measured arm.

balance: Every three-arm permutation occurs exactly once, three blocks per GPU. Each GPU executes every arm in each ordinal position once. Each block includes all4096inputs and all3models. No optional repetitions, replacement timings or dropped blocks.

fixed_separate_endpoints.arithmetic: Within each block saving=1-packed_complete_seconds/control_complete_seconds. Use exact rational arithmetic on stored measured floats. Each separate six-block median is the arithmetic mean of sorted positions3and4. Support its fixed target if median>=5%, otherwise falsify. Retain both outcomes independently; no pooled or simultaneous confidence claim and no timing confidence interval.
fixed_separate_endpoints.integrity_prerequisite: Every actual model-input final board, source choice, solver counter, finite/stopping/cap flag, numerical acceptance, hidden step and coupling must match the fully audited H2br source for its logical arm. Compare every executed BP final logit exactly and original float64 margins/energies with inherited1e-9/1e-6 tolerances and matching nonfinite masks. Normalize and compare all LP internal states, candidate scores and transcripts to H2br's full LP controls under actual global identity mappings. All repeats must preserve their sources. Any failed source preservation leaves performance conclusions incomplete; no case is dropped or repaired.
fixed_separate_endpoints.accuracy: Reported source accuracy is context from H2br. Exact preservation is an integrity condition; repeated performance copies add no fresh accuracy or population observations.

before_changed_execution_gates.source_selection: First64inputs from H2br shards0and15, all3models:128source mazes,384model-inputs per actual arm per GPU. Gate all3actual modes and all new model-readiness/host-stage branches against source states, original certificates, normalized LP transcripts and exact identities. Fixed positional selection; no errors selected for the gate.
before_changed_execution_gates.synthetic: Independently test six-permutation order balance; both exact median boundaries and all-block denominators; LP-only versus dual-model readiness; mandatory host stage cost; all original/packed identity and true-cardinality mappings; final partial batches and zero-work slots; failed worker, timeout, partial archive retention and overwrite refusal. Retain H2bs queue/trace parity gates without weakening them.
before_changed_execution_gates.warmup: Fixed first32inputs of H2br shard0, all3models, each actual mode on each GPU. Source-check outside measured cost but within worker wall budget; construct all measured models afresh afterward.
before_changed_execution_gates.review: This file authorizes no changed implementation or execution. Parent design review comes first, followed by full new source/gate packet review before changed GPU gates, and final protocol review before timing.

proposed_budgets.rationale: Eighteen full-cohort actual timed arms, source-preserving solver kernels and bounded archives, as in H2br's18arms; explicit H2bs host packing/scatter and partial-state checks are added. All limits are prospective; one attempt and no outcome-dependent extensions.

evidence: Seal all actual cohort/worker/host-stage receipts before joining either cost endpoint. Retain all six block costs for both controls, actual model readiness, queue/packing/scatter and operation components, exact global identity/cardinality/zero-slot ledgers, every state/trajectory/failure, live process/GPU counters and all source hashes. Portable evidence distinguishes complete scalar/source-preservation checks from selected original-factor fixtures and the separately retained complete trajectory audit.
